_comment: VocaTrain_backend on winhost: the slice 1 recipe (vocatrain-backend.json) with a local deploy instead of ssh from the Mac. The deploy publishes the API and the web app, so VocaTrain_web shares the vt-server group.

Runs on winhost's Windows runner (slice 2c), from the runner's own clone. Commands run in PowerShell (the recipe's shell field, read by the Windows platform in T7), so they avoid && (Windows PowerShell 5.1 lacks it).

deploy-local-winhost.ps1 publishes and installs on winhost itself, holding C:\Sites\_locks\staging.lock, the lock deploy-prod-winhost.sh takes from the Mac over ssh. remote_busy_cmd checks that lock: exit 0 = a deploy holds it, 1 = free (D18).
live_version_cmd uses type, which reads the file in both PowerShell and cmd.
build_cmd: dotnet build VocaTrain_backend/VocaTrain.WN.Api -c Release -nologo -v q; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; dotnet build VocaTrain_web/VocaTrain.WN.Web -c Release -nologo -v q
